$comment: Strings only the app needs, or where the mobile design system's wording differs from the web. Same key as packages/core/src/i18n/messages.ts overrides it; a new key adds one. Run `pnpm --filter @hw/mobile generate` after editing. Reuse web keys (ext.*, feeds.*, gauge.*, note.*) before adding one here.
